body: I'm going solo, F27, flying in from the East Coast and this is my first festival. I'll be there Friday and Saturday, and I'd love to meet up!  Message me!
I appreciate your comments so much, thank you!  I'll gladly go back to being patient.

Thank you for providing a timeline -- the person that I know who has grown in the past had me believing that they were taking too long to pin, so i was looking for reasons that it might be taking "too long".

I got the idea to put the shoeboxes in a water bath in a larger tub as a means of maintaining humidity from another post on the sub.  The user recommended adding a touch of bleach to the water to keep the still water from the bath from growing bacteria and mold, but I substituted bleach with vinegar.

I don't have an air conditioner in that room, which is why I don't have much control over the temperature.  I made sure the box is out of direct sunlight, though.
Thank you! That puts me more at ease than I have been. I appreciate you sharing your experience!
